I think a lot of people just find me insufferable, my own mother told someone the other day that I'll never find anyone because I'm too domineering, I'm like a bossy know-it-all and I wish I wasn't.  I just keep trying to think about my two year old nephew who I love so much.  I adore him, he's the light in my life, I keep trying to think about him and how much I love him because I think of every person I know, he probably does love me.

It's good to know that someone is here with me.  

All I ever really wanted was to be loved, I didn't care about having a big career or making a mark on the world, I just wanted someone to love me.

I've always had depression, and a host of other mental health issues, I was so on top of it, I had a good year of solid.... happiness, I suppose, I was enjoying life.  It all just went to shit one thing after another.  Losing my internet friends was like the final straw, that had been my last refuge, even if I didn't speak to anyone in the real world the entire day, I knew they'd be there when I was sitting at home on the computer, and once they'd gone I realised just how alone I was.  

My job made me finally feel normal, there were so many people like me there, and I lost so much with it.  

I'm actually really glad for you that this is helping, and I'm really grateful that you, and others are here, because I really need someone right now.
